name: Ogooluwani Adewale
tagline: Building fast, reliable software that people enjoy using.
about:
👋 Hey there! I'm [[NAME]] [[SPEAKER]], a Software Developer with over five years of experience building web and mobile applications that are fast, reliable and designed around real user needs. For me, software development goes beyond writing code. It's about solving problems, creating meaningful experiences and building products that people genuinely enjoy using.

💻 Over the years, I've worked across enterprise platforms, media products, logistics solutions and business applications, helping teams turn ideas into software that delivers real value. My work spans modern web applications, cross-platform mobile apps and the backend services that power them. Whether I'm building from scratch or improving an existing product, I care deeply about writing maintainable code and creating experiences that feel effortless.

🚀 What excites me most is the challenge of bringing ideas to life. I enjoy working at the intersection of design and engineering, where performance, usability and thoughtful interactions come together to create products that not only work well but leave a lasting impression.

🎨 Beyond the code, I'm constantly learning, experimenting and refining my craft. Technology moves quickly, and I enjoy exploring new tools, improving my workflow and discovering better ways to build products that are scalable, accessible and enjoyable to use.

🙌 I value collaboration, curiosity and ownership. I enjoy working with designers, developers and product teams to solve real problems, share ideas and ship quality software. At the end of the day, my goal is simple: build products that make a difference and leave every project better than I found it.

Let's build something remarkable together. 🤝✨

education.title: B.Sc Economics
education.description: Completed a rigorous four-year program in Economics with a focus on quantitative analysis, policy evaluation, and research. Actively engaged in leadership and student governance, blending academic excellence with organizational impact.
achievements: Strengthened student leadership culture by contributing to the Leadership Qualities & Entrepreneurial Development (LQED) Committee, helping organize programs that improved entrepreneurial awareness among peers.
Led the technical team of the Nigerian Economics Students’ Association (NESA OAU), introducing digital tools that improved event coordination and boosted student engagement.
Oversaw a fair and transparent electoral process as Electoral Chairman of NESA OAU, successfully managing student elections with high participation and credibility.
